long_biography.plain_text:
At Labelmakers, Kevin Bamford brought production of adhesive-coated materials into the same business as label printing. Technical manager Graeme Lang established the coatings division, which developed adhesives for Australian bottling conditions and materials for beer and dairy labels. Making these materials internally gave the company greater control over costs and product development.

Labelmakers acquired Le Mac Australia in 2019, adding a major producer of labels that need no disposable backing liner. Le Mac also brought shrink-sleeve and tamper-evident packaging capabilities, broadening the group's range for food and other consumer-goods manufacturers.
long_biography.html:
At Labelmakers, Kevin Bamford brought production of adhesive-coated materials into the same business as label printing. Technical manager Graeme Lang established the coatings division, which developed adhesives for Australian bottling conditions and materials for beer and dairy labels. Making these materials internally gave the company greater control over costs and product development.

Labelmakers acquired Le Mac Australia in 2019, adding a major producer of labels that need no disposable backing liner. Le Mac also brought shrink-sleeve and tamper-evident packaging capabilities, broadening the group's range for food and other consumer-goods manufacturers.
